verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs say it serves local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and on the network. The CLI provides `lms server start` and `lms server stop`, and models load on demand when a request arrives. Community users independently confirm the OpenAI-compatible server makes it easy to spin up and test. Missing for 10: an explicit enumeration in the evidence of which OpenAI-compatible routes are supported (e.g. chat/completions, embeddings paths).

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: Serve local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and on the network
Start and stop the local server ... lms server start / lms server stop
to use a model, simply send an inferencing request to it. If the model is not yet loaded, it'll be loaded before your request returns.
the OpenAI server makes it really easy to spin up a server and test
